abilities.descEn: Some of the Mineral used to produce that Ranger is restored when they are defeated.
abilities.descZh: Ranger被打倒時可回收一部份生產該Ranger時所消耗的礦物。

abilities.descEn: Occasionally avoids the effects of Tornado and Thunderstorm items.
abilities.descZh: 該Ranger能夠在一定機率下閃避「龍捲風／大雷雨」的道具效果。

abilities.descEn: Gives a high chance of increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed. This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
abilities.descZh: 出動擁有此能力的Ranger時，能以高機率增加敵方隊伍1隻Ranger的生產礦物成本。此能力可於戰鬥開始10秒後發動。
